en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

Being trapped in this academy is making
me pretty depressed...

...but we should come up with fun ideas
during times like these!

Umm...
I don't really wanna watch anything scary...

How about we watch something happier
instead?

Musicals are good!
It makes me wanna sing!

I like piano ballads best, but I generally
like all music.

It's pretty cool that you understand
my hobby.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaede looks deep in thought...
